Name: Rideable Skateboard - Flip Tricks - Grinds
Author: gorilakila
Description:
[left][b][color=#d4d4d8][size=6]Skateboard[/size][/color][/b][/left]
[left][color=#D4D4D8][i]Push around the valley, pop ollies, flip tricks and grind every fence in town.[/i][/color][/left]
[left][/left]
[line]
[color=#D4D4D8]
[size=5][b]What it does[/b][/size]

[/color]
[list]

[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Rideable skate board.[/b] Using standard movement controls: push up to speed, carve turns, coast, and drag a foot to brake. You'll be faster than running in about half a second, and near horse speed on stone, wood and paths. Grass and dirt are a little slower.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Simple controls - two buttons, many tricks.[/b] Press [b]Ollie[/b] to jump. Press [b]Trick[/b] for a random flip: kickflips, heelflips, shove-its, varials, 360 flips, laser flips, impossibles. Tricks always fit the air you've got, so they never make you bail. Bigger air means bigger tricks, and doubles and 540s come out when you pop off a rail. This is a mobility mod first and foremost so none of the trick features are meant to complicate that.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Manuals.[/b] Keep the trick button held as you land and you roll away on two wheels. You keep your speed, there's no balancing, and it keeps your combo going.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Grind (almost) everything:[/b]
[/color]
[list]

[*][color=#D4D4D8]Fences you place: wood, stone, iron, hardwood, closed gates.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Fences painted into the maps: farm borders, the Bus Stop, Backwoods, the town picket fences.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Bridge sides: Town's stone bridges, the Mountain bridges, the Forest plank bridge.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]The beach pier and the Ginger Island dock.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Stardew Valley Expanded[/b]'s white fences and the Shearwater Bridge.[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]Rails never slow you down; they build you up to top speed.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Combos.[/b] Tricks, grinds and manuals chain together, with trick names and scores popping up over your head.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Swing your sword while you ride.[/b] Melee weapons work on the board, and it keeps rolling through the swing.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Never stuck.[/b] Land somewhere you shouldn't (inside a wall, in the water) and you're popped out to open ground. Hold [b]noclip[/b] to ride out of anywhere else.[/color][/*]
[/list]

[line]
[color=#D4D4D8]
[size=5][b]Getting a board[/b][/size]

Buy one at [b]Pierre's General Store[/b] (750g, adjustable in the config), or type [font=Courier New]skate_give[/font] in the SMAPI console.

Hop on by using the board (left click with it selected), or press [b]B[/b]. Use it again or press B to hop off.

[/color]
[line]
[color=#D4D4D8]
[size=5][b]Controls[/b][/size]

[/color]
[list]

[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Hop on / off:[/b] B, or the use-tool button with the board selected [i](controller: left stick click, or X with the board selected)[/i][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Push / steer:[/b] movement keys [i](controller: left stick, with analog carving)[/i][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Brake:[/b] hold the opposite direction[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Ollie:[/b] Space [i](controller: A)[/i][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Trick:[/b] Q, and hold it through a landing to manual [i](controller: B)[/i][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Noclip (hold):[/b] N [i](controller: right stick click)[/i][/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]
To grind, ride alongside a fence (or straight at the end of one) and ollie. While grinding:
[/color]
[list]

[*][color=#D4D4D8]Ollie pops you off; hold a direction across the rail to hop off to that side.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Trick pops you off into a trick.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Riding off the end launches you clear of whatever post or sign caps the fence.[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]
Every key can be rebound.

[/color]
[line]
[color=#D4D4D8]
[size=5][b]Configuration[/b][/size]

Everything is in [font=Courier New]config.json[/font] (created on first launch), or in-game with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]:
[/color]
[list]

[*][color=#D4D4D8]Keybinds for every action[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Top speed, push strength, turn speed, ollie strength[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Whether ground type affects speed, and whether you ride with a sideways stance[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Wall-slam bails on or off, and trick name popups[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Whether you need the item to ride, whether skating is allowed indoors, sounds, and the price at Pierre's[/color][/*]
[/list]

[line]
[color=#D4D4D8]
[size=5][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[/color]
[list]

[*][color=#D4D4D8]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] 4.0+[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][i]Optional:[/i] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url][/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]
[size=5][b]Installation[/b][/size]
[/color]
[list=1]

[*][color=#D4D4D8]Install SMAPI.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Unzip into your [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font] folder.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Run the game through SMAPI.[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]
[size=5][b]Uninstalling[/b][/size]
Sell or trash your skateboard first. Otherwise it turns into an error item once the mod is gone.

[/color]
[line]
[color=#D4D4D8]
[size=5][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]
[/color]
[list]

[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Stardew Valley Expanded:[/b] supported, and its fences and bridges are grindable.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Other map mods:[/b] everything works, but fences drawn with their own custom tilesheets may not be grindable. Placed fences always are. Map rails come from [font=Courier New]assets/map-rails.json[/font] (tilesheet name → tile indices), so you can add more.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Multiplayer:[/b] supported but not tested much yet. Everyone should install it. Other players with the mod see your board, tricks and manuals. Bug reports welcome.[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]
[size=5][b]Console commands[/b][/size]
[/color]
[list]

[*][color=#D4D4D8][font=Courier New]skate_give[/font]: adds a skateboard to your inventory.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][font=Courier New]skate_toggle[/font]: hops you on or off.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][font=Courier New]skate_rail [length] [h|v][/font]: builds a straight wood-fence practice rail in front of you. These are real fences, so they stay until you remove them.[/color][/*]
[/list]

[line]


[center][color=#D4D4D8]Have fun![/color][/center]
